Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 55: the slip of [[Stinger (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“May add 1 pilot. Guri deploys -3 aboard. While Guri piloting, during any control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck (if Chewie or Leia on table, Force Pile instead) and immune to attrition < 5.”), word for word the text of [[Stinger (V) (Virtual Block 4)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
